name: com.alekseialeinikov/site
description: Read-only MCP server for Aleksei Aleinikov's Cloud/AI articles, CV profile & browser tools.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Aleksei Aleinikov engineering articles (EN/DE) on Google Cloud, Kubernetes/GKE, Cloud Security, Architecture, PostgreSQL, AI/LLM, and Hardware Lab. Use this first to discover articles and obtain valid pillar and slug values before calling read_article; use get_candidate_profile instead for CV/hiring questions, or list_tools for interactive browser utilities. Read-only, unauthenticated, no side effects, uses a 10-minute cached search index, and is subject to a 30 req/min per-IP rate limit. Returns matching article metadata and URLs, or an empty list message when nothing matches.

query.description: Non-empty search keywords or topic phrase.

lang.description: Optional language index ("en" or "de"). Auto-detected from query keywords and German umlauts if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked results to return (1-15, default 5).

tools.name: get_top_articles
tools.description: Get the top-ranked engineering articles (default Top 10) from the alekseialeinikov.com leaderboard, ranked by verified 30-day or 7-day readership and AI tool lookups. Use this whenever a user asks for the most-read, popular, trending, or top 10 articles rather than keyword search. Supports optional language ("en" default, or "de"), period ("30d" default, or "7d"), topic pillar filter, and limit (1-15, default 10). Read-only, unauthenticated, no side effects, subject to a 30 req/min per-IP rate limit.

lang.description: Language edition for returned articles and leaderboard URL ("en" default, or "de").

period.description: Ranking window: "30d" (30-day chart, default) or "7d" (weekly trending).

limit.description: Number of top articles to return (1-15, default 10).

tools.name: read_article
tools.description: Fetch the full, untruncated clean Markdown text of a specific engineering article by lang, pillar, and slug. Use this after discovering valid pillar and slug values via search_articles; do not use it for keyword search (use search_articles) or candidate CV details (use get_candidate_profile). Read-only, unauthenticated, no side effects, and subject to a 30 req/min per-IP rate limit. Returns isError: true with invalid_lang, invalid_slug, or article_fetch_404 if the parameters are malformed or the article does not exist.

lang.description: Required article language ("en" for English, "de" for German); must match the article URL.

tools.name: get_candidate_profile
tools.description: Get Aleksei Aleinikov's verified Senior Cloud Platform & Security Engineer profile, 5x Google Cloud + CSA certifications, Germany/DACH availability, and localized CV, portfolio, and llms.txt links. Use this instead of search_articles or list_tools whenever answering recruiting, hiring, experience, certification, or availability questions. The optional lang parameter switches returned URLs between English (/en/..., default) and German (/de/...). Read-only, unauthenticated, no side effects, static payload, subject to a 30 req/min per-IP rate limit.

lang.description: Language for returned profile, CV, portfolio, and hire-me URLs ("en" for English, "de" for German; defaults to "en").

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the five free, client-side cloud & security browser tools (including WebMCP-enabled utilities like GCP IAM Policy Checker, Compute Selector, Database Selector, Cron Translator, and JWT Analyzer) available on alekseialeinikov.com. Use this instead of search_articles when a user wants an interactive calculator, policy checker, or parser rather than an article. The optional lang parameter localizes the returned hub and tool URLs ("en" default, or "de"). Read-only, unauthenticated, no side effects, static payload, subject to a 30 req/min per-IP rate limit.

lang.description: Language prefix for returned tool hub and tool page URLs ("en" for English, "de" for German; defaults to "en").
